unsatisfiable_gates_found.gate: cpu_parity / half_parity elementwise-all gate vs discrete reference-view argmin
unsatisfiable_gates_found.detail: with cam_token=None and S=3 == THRESH_FOR_REF_SELECTION=3, select_reference_view('saddle_balanced') does balance_score.argmin over 3 views then reorder_by_reference / restore_original_order. A flip of that discrete argmin between CPU and MPS (or fp32/fp16) permutes the outputs and fails the elementwise gate by O(1) regardless of atol/rtol. balance_score is a sum of three |.|-0.5 terms over min-max-normalised triples, so near-ties are structurally likely.

ExplicitPrecisionDA3 disables autocast and casts input to fp16, forcing LayerNorm/softmax/torch.quantile/torch.linalg.inv into fp16. fp16 u=4.88e-4; gate is max over ~353k elements (~4.5 sigma); needs per-element sigma <~2e-3 while a deep ViT in fp16 typically sits at 1e-3-1e-2. Roughly a coin flip. Also LayerNorm eps=1e-6 underflows to 0 in fp16.
same precision, different backend (Accelerate vs Metal); typical per-element relative diff 1e-5-1e-4, max over 353k elements ~1e-4-5e-4 vs rtol=1e-3. Probably passes with 2-10x margin but not roomy.
